feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Hit a midlife wall? This test identifies your strengths and what matters to you
entry.summary: As part of her new podcast and newsletter Your Turn with Allison Aubrey, NPR's Allison Aubrey went in search of tools to help navigate midlife — starting with this survey to rank one's character strengths.

entry.title: Suspicious mailings to election officials, congressional offices under investigation
entry.summary: The FBI and U.S. Postal Inspection Service are looking into the mailings, some of which included an unidentified powdery white substance.

entry.title: U.S. historic preservation law faces the most serious threat in its 60-year history
entry.summary: Congress and a federal agency are threatening to weaken the country's historic preservation law, fueling a backlash that critics say is as fiery as the one that led to the law's creation 60 years ago.

entry.title: Inside a Chicago home, a photographer documents the life her family built
entry.summary: For eight years, photographer Jennifer Teresa Villanueva has documented her Mexican American family's everyday life in Chicago, capturing intimate moments of love, labor and sacrifice.

entry.title: After booting 760K off ACA health plans, the Trump administration adds some people back
entry.summary: The Trump administration provided few details about its process for canceling hundreds of thousands of Affordable Care Act enrollments — even as the next stage of the anti-fraud effort is underway.

entry.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries, officials say, after brief truce
entry.summary: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over.

entry.title: Greetings from Mexico City, where a bullfighting ban doesn't stop this matador training
entry.summary: One plays the bull, the other the bullfighter, as a pair practices a dance of death in a sport that's prohibited in the Mexican capital city.

entry.title: Make a 'sick day' kit for cold and flu season before your household gets hit
entry.summary: Cold and flu season is here. Before someone in your household gets hit, make sure you have these essential meds and comfort items in your medicine cabinet.

entry.title: These swing voters regret voting for Trump and it's influencing their midterm choices
entry.summary: Some key voters in Georgia say deep frustration and disappointment with President Trump are motivating their election plans just weeks before Election Day.
